name: Rewards Card
description: An onboarding card on the shadcn "Nova" preset — Stone neutrals, Blue primary, radius 0 — sharing its token object with the Upgrade Modal so the two read as one system. The blue haze across the top is the layer-blur trick rather than a gradient: one ellipse in chart-1 pushed 230px above the card and blurred by 90px, clipped by the card edge, so it fades into the white with nothing to tune. Three 96px tiles sit in a row with the middle one lifted 8px, each with a 4px inset white border and carrying a hand-drawn line illustration composed on a 96 grid in the reference style — single-weight ink, one off-white paper shape behind it, exactly one accent per tile. They read as a story: a watering can raising three coin-headed sprouts (grow your earnings), a wrapped gift box with a primary ribbon (the reward), and a cursor tapping a checklist with the first box ticked (the easy action). Centred copy beneath, subtext locked to 250px so it breaks on two lines, and a soft primary action — primary-foreground fill, primary text — spanning the card. Renders entirely on the server.

variations.name: default
variations.description: An onboarding card on the shadcn Nova preset with a layer-blurred blue haze across the top, three inset-bordered tiles carrying hand-drawn ink illustrations — watering can and coin sprouts, gift box, tapped checklist — centred copy and a soft primary action. Every value reads from one token object shared with the Upgrade Modal. Static — no hooks, no motion, zero JavaScript.

props.name: title
props.description: Centred heading under the tiles. Defaults to "Get rewarded fast".

props.name: subtext
props.description: Muted line under the title, capped at 250px so it breaks on two lines. Defaults to "Choose and earn fast with these simple offers."

props.name: ctaLabel
props.description: Label on the soft primary action. Defaults to "Show 10 easy offers". Drawn, not wired.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the card root. Capped at 496px wide; the haze, the tile row and the subtext measure were composed against that width.
